annotation.title_clean: Projeto regulamenta uso da inteligência artificial no Brasil
annotation.title_en: Bill regulates use of artificial intelligence in Brazil
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agência Câmara de Notícias (Câmara dos Deputados)
annotation.summary_en: Chamber of Deputies news item describing Senate-approved Bill 2338/23 on AI regulation in Brazil, now before the Chamber. It sets risk-based classification, bans excessive-risk systems including autonomous weapons, restricts facial recognition in public spaces, and addresses copyright in AI training.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI systems classified by risk level; preliminary risk assessment mandatory for generative and general-purpose AI
Excessive-risk systems prohibited, including autonomous weapons selecting and attacking targets without human intervention
Facial recognition in public spaces allowed only in specific cases with judicial authorization
Copyright holders may bar use of protected works and are entitled to remuneration for commercial AI training
Bill approved by Senate; must pass the Chamber to become law
